item.title: Join Staff
item.dc:creator: Codex
item.content:encoded:
GoldStandardX Gaming

Join Staff

Help operate a growing multi-game network with professionalism, consistency, and respect for the players who make the community active.

Sign Staff ApplicationBack to Main Site
Contacts

Leadership & Contacts

Reach the people who run GSXG. Replace the email addresses below with the real ones (edit this page in WordPress).

Owner

Tobbie330
Email: owner@goldstandardxgaming.org
Edit: replace with the owner’s real email.

Head Admin

Chuck • TK • Chad
Email: headadmin@goldstandardxgaming.org
Edit: add each head admin’s real email here.

General Staff Contact

For staff questions and applications.
Email: staff@goldstandardxgaming.org
Or open a support ticket.

What Staff Do

Support the Community

  • Answer player questions and guide new members.
  • Help enforce rules fairly and consistently.
  • Assist with tickets, events, server feedback, and community communication.
  • Represent GSXG with maturity in-game and on Discord.
What We Look For

Staff Expectations

  • Professional communication and patience.
  • Reliable activity and willingness to learn.
  • No abuse of permissions or favoritism.
  • Ability to follow leadership direction and document issues clearly.
Application Path

Ready to Help?

Complete the staff application and agreement form. Include the server you play on, your experience, availability, and why you want to help GSXG grow.

Sign Staff ApplicationOpen Support Ticket
Original Staff Site Content

Staff Program Details

Brought over from the old staff.goldstandardxgaming.org site.

Why Become Staff?

  • Be part of a growing multi-game survival community.
  • Help create an enjoyable environment for players across multiple games.
  • Work alongside experienced administrators and leadership.
  • Earn advancement through Trial Moderator, Moderator, Admin, Head Admin, and Leadership.

Professional Tools

  • Unified Operations Panel
  • ServerOpsX
  • Ticket management systems
  • Uptime monitoring
  • BattleMetrics integration
  • Server Armour
  • Knowledge base and documentation

What We Look For

  • Mature and professional
  • Active and reliable
  • Team-oriented
  • Willing to learn
  • Strong communicator
  • Fair and unbiased
  • Passionate about gaming

Staff Expectations

  • Assist players professionally.
  • Handle tickets and support requests.
  • Enforce community rules fairly.
  • Document actions when required.
  • Maintain confidentiality when appropriate.
  • Represent GSXG positively.

Administrative Experience

  • Community management
  • Conflict resolution
  • Team leadership
  • Server administration
  • Discord moderation
  • Ticket support
  • Event planning

Original Staff Roster

Owner: Tobbie330
Discord Developers: Carl
Creator: Personal Discord, Company Discord
Head Admin: Chuck, TK, Chad
Plugin Assistance: Avva
Admins: Jason, Adam
Moderators: To be expanded as staff grows.
